```
['build the grpcio Python package with Cython extensions using python setup.py build', 'check if the system linker requires libatomic by compiling a C++11 atomic test program', 'configure and return Cython extension modules and whether Cython is needed for the build', 'build the grpcio package using the system OpenSSL installation via GRPC_PYTHON_BUILD_SYSTEM_OPENSSL env var', 'build the grpcio Python layer using prebuilt gRPC Core libraries via GRPC_PYTHON_USE_PREBUILT_GRPC_CORE']
```

